syncMode.label: Sync Mode
syncMode.description: When syncing from a database source, define the type of database operation which trigger syncs to Display & Video 360.

choices.label: Add - triggers when a row is added

Delete - triggers when a row is deleted
Mirror - triggers when a row is added, updated or deleted
